Header banner for /collections/acetyl-hexapeptide-8.

SOURCE: banner library, acetyl-hexapeptide-8-serum--G-face-full-over-shoulder gpt_image_01 (2048x848, 2.42:1). Label checked at 100%: Skingenetix / ACETYL HEXAPEPTIDE-8 / ANTI-WRINKLE all crisp and correct; SERUM and PREMIUM FORMULA fall out of focus below them, which is the library brief's own instruction and not a rendering fault.

CANVAS EXTENDED, NOT CROPPED. The banner box is 100vw x 440px, so its aspect follows the viewport - 3.27:1 at 1440, 3.44:1 at 1512, 4.36:1 at 1920 - and a 2.42:1 frame is narrower than all of them, so object-fit cover would crop the height and take the top of her head. Extended leftward to 3750x848 (4.42:1), past the widest of those. object-position is right center, so surplus width is only ever cropped off the extension.

THE EASY CASE, AND MEASURED TO CONFIRM IT RATHER THAN ASSUMED. The leftmost columns read mean 11-15 with a max of 16 from top to bottom, i.e. flat backdrop, so unlike the copper peptide day cream nothing had to be sheared out of frame.

TEXTURE BOX CHOSEN BY MEASUREMENT. rows 0-650 cols 0-400 measures max 25 against a backdrop of ~14. The wider (0,300,0,900) box looks equally like backdrop and is not - max 164, her hair - and mirror-tiling that is exactly what printed ghosts across the day cream banner an hour earlier.
